text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Tazuna pays a visit to my
office.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Trainer! I hope I'm not
interrupting
anything!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Only a handful of students at the
academy have
been able to find such
success over the past three
years.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy that I could watch over you
both this
entire time! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
choice_data_list: Thank you as well for watching ove...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Would you and your trainee care to join
me after
this?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
But let's buy some apples for everyone
first!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, the three of us feast on
ramen and
pan-fried dumplings.
